channel.title: Kimani Upshur Daily Devotional
channel.description: A fresh Bible devotional every day from Kimani Upshur, M.Ed.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Psalm 91:1
item.description:
“He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.”

Psalm 91:1 (KJV)

There's a secret place with God — close, sheltered, safe. Dwelling there isn't a one-time visit; it's where you live. Stay close to Him today and rest under His shadow.

Prayer: Almighty God, I dwell in Your secret place today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Luke 19:10
item.description:
“For the Son of man is come to seek and to save that which was lost.”

Luke 19:10 (KJV)

Jesus did not wait for the lost to find Him; He came seeking. If you feel lost today, know this: you are being looked for. And if you are found, join the search for others.

Prayer: Jesus, thank You for seeking and saving me.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Psalm 119:18
item.description:
“Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.”

Psalm 119:18 (KJV)

The Bible is full of wonders, but you need opened eyes to see them. Before you read Scripture today, ask God to show you something wonderful. He loves to reveal Himself in His Word.

Prayer: Lord, open my eyes to see wonders in Your Word today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 10:27
item.description:
“My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me:”

John 10:27 (KJV)

Jesus knows you personally, and you can know His voice. The closer you walk with Him, the clearer He sounds.

Prayer: Lord, help me hear and follow Your voice.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 16:24
item.description:
“Hitherto have ye asked nothing in my name: ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.”

John 16:24 (KJV)

Jesus wants your joy to be full, and He connects that joy to asking in His name. Prayer is not a chore; it is the doorway to full joy. Ask Him for what you need today.

Prayer: Jesus, I ask in Your name; fill my joy today.

item.title: Daily Devotional: Malachi 3:10
item.description:
“Bring ye all the tithes into the storehouse, that there may be meat in mine house, and prove me now herewith, saith the LORD of hosts, if I will not open you the windows of heaven, and pour you out a blessing, that there shall not be room enough to receive it.”

Malachi 3:10 (KJV)

God invites you to test Him in giving; it's the one place He says prove me. Generosity opens heaven's windows over your life.

Prayer: Father, I give cheerfully; open the windows of heaven over me.

item.title: Daily Devotional: John 6:35
item.description:
“And Jesus said unto them, I am the bread of life: he that cometh to me shall never hunger; and he that believeth on me shall never thirst.”

John 6:35 (KJV)

Just as bread satisfies hunger, Jesus satisfies your soul's deepest hunger. Come to Him and you'll never be empty again.

Prayer: Jesus, be the bread that satisfies my soul.
